rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a fair/good Day 5 3BB blastocyst, noting loose ICM/TE and possible partial collapse, but it over-speculates about collapse/handling and grading inconsistency from a single image.
Integrates age, prior live birth/biochemical pregnancy, AMH, smoking, endometrium, sperm parameters, and Day 5 development into prognosis well, though some links are somewhat generic.
Final assessment is mostly logical, but the response contains internal hedging and repeated uncertainty about grading, freeze-all, and probability ranges before settling on a conclusion.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer at age 29, smoking cessation, no routine add-ons, and cautious stance on PGT-A. Minor deviations include speculative freeze-all/embryo banking discussion without clear indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking cessation, review of lab performance, and avoiding unnecessary add-ons, though some recommendations remain somewhat broad.
